name: bharat-registry
description: Blockchain-based Land Registry System with Zero-Gas Permissioned Network

scripts.install:all: cd blockchain && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.deploy:besu: cd blockchain && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy-besu.js --network besu
scripts.test:besu: cd blockchain && npx hardhat run scripts/test-besu.js --network besu
scripts.frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run start

author: Bharat Registry Team
